context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature Flags system fully functional. Key endpoints: GET /api/clinic/features (returns features array and plan code for clinic user), GET /api/admin/plans (returns 3 plans: basic $29, professional $79, enterprise $199), GET /api/admin/features (returns all 16 features), GET /api/admin/clinics/{id}/features (returns features with in_plan and override flags), PUT /api/admin/clinics/{id}/plan (changes clinic plan).
